QuestInfo.name: Gathering Food 2
QuestInfo.1: Help Camila get food ingredients for the people of Henesys.
QuestInfo.2: You have brought food to the people of Henesys.

0.0: It's good to see you again. Thank you again for before. We all enjoyed the snail. I don't suppose you could help me again?

yes.0: I'm going to try cooking a mushroom dish this time. Mushrooms are supposed to lower cholesterol and fight disease, you know. We all need to be at our healthiest, or a mutant might eat us.\r\nPlease get me about 80 Mutant Mushroom Caps. Oh, it will be so nice to cook a meal with ingredients other than dirt and twigs!

1.0: Did you get all the Mushroom Caps?

yes.0: Thank you very much. I'll get to work cooking this right away!

item.0: We'll need about 80 Mushroom Caps to feed everyone here.
